name: Brill Town Hall
summary: In Brill Town Hall, the Forsaken govern Brill and plan Tirisfal's defense. Its doors stand in Lordaeron's shattered heart.

sections.title: Civic Seat of the Forsaken
sections.body: Forsaken rule continues from Brill Town Hall while much of Lordaeron lies in ruins. Magistrate Sevren directs town affairs from his podium and gives orders to Forsaken travelers. Few known town halls remain active under Forsaken control. Beyond the Defiler's Den in the Arathi Highlands, Brill's hall is among them. It keeps Lordaeron's old civic order alive beneath undead rule.

faq.q: What is the Brill Town Hall used for?
faq.answer: Brill Town Hall is where Brill's Forsaken govern. Magistrate Sevren and other leaders direct local defense, issue decrees, and assign work to travelers and newly awakened undead.
Magistrate Sevren presides over Brill Town Hall from his podium. He manages town affairs for the Forsaken and directs their operations across central Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why is this town hall notable compared to others?
aliases: are there other forsaken town halls
faq.answer: Brill Town Hall is one of the few active civic halls run by the Forsaken. The Defiler's Den in Arathi is another; most town halls belong to living human kingdoms.

angles.text: As a Forsaken setting out from Deathknell, you find your first taste of organized civic rule under Queen Sylvanas here. Brill Town Hall formally arranges local defense and efforts to reclaim the land.
As a Horde ally arriving in Tirisfal, you can visit Brill Town Hall and see how the Forsaken keep civil authority and military order in their darkened homeland.
